2.1 Leaflet is a powerful R package designed for creating interactive maps. It provides an intuitive way to visualise geographic data and is widely used in data science, spatial analysis and dashboard development.

Ensuring whether the leaflet package is installed or not
```{r}
"leaflet" %in% rownames(installed.packages())
```

Since the above code returned TRUE, we do not need to install the leaflet package again.
